column2: Paano mag-reverse ng linked list in-place?
column3: Gamitin ang three pointers: prev, curr, next.
column4: var prev = null; var curr = head; while(curr) { next=curr.next; curr.next=prev; prev=curr; curr=next }

column2: Paano mag-find ng kth from end?
column3: Gamitin ang two pointers: advance ang first ng k steps.
column4: fast = head; for i in 0..k: fast = fast.next; while(fast) { slow=slow.next; fast=fast.next }
